notes.title: Gods of Havoc - Trilogy
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35397735/784fd00bc6fd1e4322fac50b082b368a3687936b.png[/img]

[h1]Gods of Havoc heralds a return to the classic God-Game.[/h1]

Gods of Havoc is a three-part series offering difficult, turn-based strategy. Each game places the player as a god in different eras of a planet’s history.
 
[list]
[*] Fall to Earth: takes place in an early medieval setting;
[*] After the Fall: takes place in a post-apocalyptic one;
[*] Into the Void: takes place in a galactic scale.
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1117340/Gods_of_Havoc_Into_the_Void/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1120770/Gods_of_Havoc_Fall_to_Earth/
 
‘Fall to Earth’ and ‘Into the Void’, are set to be released in August 2019 with ‘After the Fall’ to be released in December 2019.

Don't forget to wishlist for more news on all three games! Visit https://www.gods-of-havoc.com/ for more information!

notes.title: Patch 1.2.6 (bug fixes and balances)
notes.content:

* Higher chance at finding valuable loot on planets.
* All quests will now spawn with equal weight.
* Assassin guild counter should now work correctly.
* Higher chance of unique armour during Collector guild missions.

* More minor bugfixes and balances

notes.title: Apocalypse Hotel - The Post_apocalyptic Hotel Simulator! OUT NOW!
notes.content:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/423700?beta=0

After the alien invasion: the Gogfang began terraforming Earth, pumping out toxic chemicals to transform it into the perfect trans-dimensional, methane paradise… the process should take fifty years.

In the meantime the strange blend of chemicals has begun to mutate the populace, turning some into hideous, fish-people, and reanimating the dead. So far you have been immune to these changes and have fought your way across the country back to your parents’ hotel, hoping they are still alive.

Whether they are or not, you have decided to make a go of it, to repair and renovate their unsightly, sixties-styled hotel into a community where people can be safe from the aliens, mutants, and zombies. Of course… they will have to pay you for the service.
 
[h2]Features:[/h2]
[b]
Improve your hotel:[/b]
•	Repair and renovate the dilapidated hotel.
•	Decorate over 20 rooms in different styles to attract different guests.
•	Decorate your hotel with unique art and objects found in the world. 
•	Craft completely new looks for your lobby and bar.
•	Hire entertainers to improve your desirability.

[b]Attract interesting and diverse guests:[/b]
•	Make people pay for the privilege of staying alive at your hotel.
•	Attract specialist guests like engineers, scavengers, and promoters.
•	Find unique survivors who you can equip and take with you on zombie-slaying adventures.
•	Seek alliances with other races, and build specialist rooms to attract them to your hotel.
[b]
Huge crafting system:[/b]
•	Over 100 items to scavenge and craft into useful tools.
•	Find food in fridges and cook meals for your guests.
•	Upgrade your guns and craft ammo for them.
•	Create useful tools and ‘room packs’ for your hotel.
•	Create special drugs to enhance your zombie dog.

[b]Exciting and scary exploration:[/b]
•	Day and night system where zombies are scarier at night.
•	Drive around a city looking for quests and missions.
•	Explore the streets on foot.
•	Enter every house, sewer, or dwelling.
[b]
Companion System:[/b]
•	Interact with every companion.
•	Equip them with armour and weaponry.
•	Command groups using hotkeys.

[b]Non-Compulsory Storyline:[/b]
•	Interact with three other factions living in the city.
•	Discover why the Gogfang have come to Earth.
•	Save the world from certain destruction?

notes.title: 'Apocalypse Hotel' Kickstarter and Greenlight!
notes.content:
[h1]KICKSTARTER DETAILS:

[url=http://kck.st/1WX1kyi] Follow this link to our Kickstarter page![/url][/h1]

[h1]GREENLIGHT DETAILS:[/h1]

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=519412421

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/004/895/487/a39c93d1bfa4d7871dfbe41e457c8109_original.png?v=1447329026&w=680&fit=max&auto=format&lossless=true&s=ebea7bd2f8360486be879d66df372868[/img]


As a survivor of the apocalypse, you have moved from location to location, from safehouse to safehouse, always running from the zombie horde. Fed up with the bleak and abysmal apocalypse, you return to your parent’s hotel in the hope to reclaim your birthright and to rebuild the once famous hotel into a safe and secure refuge against the terrors of the new world.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/004/895/438/fcc900a943170d2d5167860822234384_original.png?v=1447328127&w=680&fit=max&auto=format&lossless=true&s=15a5d9d7d7e459e4d44dca7ed563d4c7[/img]

[h1]Build and renovate a hotel amidst the backdrop of a zombie apocalypse.[/h1]

•	Renovate and repair the newly named ‘Apocalypse Hotel’.
•	Play host to hundreds of unique guests.
•	Build a variety of different rooms to attract different customers.
•	Put on entertainment in the form of zombie pit fights.
•	Keep your guests fed and happy or risk them leaving for a more comfortable safehouse.
•	House up to 50 survivors in your hotel at any one time.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/004/895/441/0d72e784ed8f581af6547935025529d2_original.png?v=1447328225&w=680&fit=max&auto=format&lossless=true&s=668ed359b543e8ccfc6f904c6f0505b6[/img]

[h1]Explore the surrounding city for supplies and to find survivors to join you.[/h1]

•	Action RPG with pistols, flame throwers, military lasers, machine guns, and chainsaws
•	Drive around a dynamic city where new quests can appear at any time.
•	Listen to the radio in order to learn of survivors or hidden caches.
•	Fight your way through the city, explore every house, and explore creepy and dark hospitals.
•	Atmospheric torchlight system that is truly frightening.
•	Choose to take your pet zombie dog or up to 8 other survivors.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/004/895/447/bac17983e4b4a038b8de795002bb5719_original.png?v=1447328349&w=680&fit=max&auto=format&lossless=true&s=880346dbc0f4628e4ce2757df2a771eb[/img]

[h1]Scavenge the world and craft your way to success.[/h1]

•	Scavenge hundreds of items from around the world.
•	Craft new guns and upgrade your old ones.
•       Cook meals for your guests or to use as health packs.
•       Take materials from abandoned houses to create new rooms for your hotel.
•       Enhance your Zombie Dog by creating new genetic recipes.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/004/895/453/169608cf88b025f4610154b075d4bd6e_original.png?v=1447328453&w=680&fit=max&auto=format&lossless=true&s=8fe003be2ba0849c6d7281133fb33845[/img]

[h1]Equip your allies and take them with you. [/h1]

•	Equip your survivor friends with armour and guns and take them on quests. 
•	Command your allies individually by talking to them individually. 
•	Shout out commands to your group and watch them obey. 
•	Use your pet to discover secrets or buff your party.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/004/895/475/5091bce87d9490fea04ef576221cd210_original.png?v=1447328705&w=680&fit=max&auto=format&lossless=true&s=de12653c10cc30bc708a6e82d31c9c79[/img]

[h1]Enjoy a non-compulsory 20 hour storyline. [/h1]

•       Discover the truth behind the zombie apocalypse. 
•	Go to space! 
•	Learn to control the zombie plague and work towards transforming yourself into the ultimate human/zombie hybrid!   

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/004/895/473/87b620ead03becf25a1ae30fdb03575c_original.png?v=1447328689&w=680&fit=max&auto=format&lossless=true&s=645478aab27a29b9d4c7694710b46acc[/img]

[h1]KICKSTARTER DETAILS:

[url=http://kck.st/1WX1kyi] Follow this link to our Kickstarter page![/url][/h1]

[h1]GREENLIGHT DETAILS:[/h1]

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=519412421

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/004/895/438/fcc900a943170d2d5167860822234384_original.png?v=1447328127&w=680&fit=max&auto=format&lossless=true&s=15a5d9d7d7e459e4d44dca7ed563d4c7[/img]

[h1]Build and renovate a hotel amidst the backdrop of a zombie apocalypse.[/h1]

•	Renovate and repair the newly named ‘Apocalypse Hotel’.
•	Play host to hundreds of unique guests.
•	Build a variety of different rooms to attract different customers.
•	Put on entertainment in the form of zombie pit fights.
•	Keep your guests fed and happy or risk them leaving for a more comfortable safehouse.
•	House up to 50 survivors in your hotel at any one time.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/004/895/441/0d72e784ed8f581af6547935025529d2_original.png?v=1447328225&w=680&fit=max&auto=format&lossless=true&s=668ed359b543e8ccfc6f904c6f0505b6[/img]

[h1]Explore the surrounding city for supplies and to find survivors to join you.[/h1]

•	Action RPG with pistols, flame throwers, military lasers, machine guns, and chainsaws
•	Drive around a dynamic city where new quests can appear at any time.
•	Listen to the radio in order to learn of survivors or hidden caches.
•	Fight your way through the city, explore every house, and explore creepy and dark hospitals.
•	Atmospheric torchlight system that is truly frightening.
•	Choose to take your pet zombie dog or up to 8 other survivors.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/004/895/447/bac17983e4b4a038b8de795002bb5719_original.png?v=1447328349&w=680&fit=max&auto=format&lossless=true&s=880346dbc0f4628e4ce2757df2a771eb[/img]

[h1]Scavenge the world and craft your way to success.[/h1]

•	Scavenge hundreds of items from around the world.
•	Craft new guns and upgrade your old ones.
•       Cook meals for your guests or to use as health packs.
•       Take materials from abandoned houses to create new rooms for your hotel.
•       Enhance your Zombie Dog by creating new genetic recipes.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/004/895/453/169608cf88b025f4610154b075d4bd6e_original.png?v=1447328453&w=680&fit=max&auto=format&lossless=true&s=8fe003be2ba0849c6d7281133fb33845[/img]

[h1]Equip your allies and take them with you. [/h1]

•	Equip your survivor friends with armour and guns and take them on quests. 
•	Command your allies individually by talking to them individually. 
•	Shout out commands to your group and watch them obey. 
•	Use your pet to discover secrets or buff your party.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/004/895/475/5091bce87d9490fea04ef576221cd210_original.png?v=1447328705&w=680&fit=max&auto=format&lossless=true&s=de12653c10cc30bc708a6e82d31c9c79[/img]

[h1]Enjoy a non-compulsory 20 hour storyline. [/h1]

•       Discover the truth behind the zombie apocalypse. 
•	Go to space! 
•	Learn to control the zombie plague and work towards transforming yourself into the ultimate human/zombie hybrid!   

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/004/895/473/87b620ead03becf25a1ae30fdb03575c_original.png?v=1447328689&w=680&fit=max&auto=format&lossless=true&s=645478aab27a29b9d4c7694710b46acc[/img]

[h1]KICKSTARTER DETAILS:

[url=http://kck.st/1WX1kyi] Follow this link to our Kickstarter page![/url][/h1]

[h1]GREENLIGHT DETAILS:[/h1]

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=519412421

notes.title: Patch 1.2.5 - Streamlines
notes.content:
Main:

Patch 1.2.5 helps to streamline the game, reducing load-times and the lag being felt on some computers.

Main Fixes:

Crash on entering player owned station for the first time.
Screen switching between full and window mode after death.

notes.title: Update 1.1.6 - Big fixes and Crash Fixes
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

So this is a pretty big update that should address the “GMRK:Plane” crash that was affecting some machines. There are also tons of changes to code to make the game run more smoothly across the board and which eliminates a few of the more quirky elements.

With the new baby I’ve been a little quiet on the forum but I am still ploughing away at the game and will have a pretty big announcement concerning it at the end of the week.

Thanks for playing,

Mike

notes.title: Patch 1.1.5 (Lag Fix)
notes.content:
Okay, so sorry I've been a bit dead on the forum these last 24 hours but I have been scripting non stop to fix the lag issues that were occuring on some PCs.

Yesterday I finally got my hands on a PC suffering from the same issues. I have fixed it on that one and I hope that it will now filter down to the rest of you.

As a consequence we are seeing increased frame-rates across all our machines so this should improve the gameplay experience for everyone.

notes.title: Patch 1.1.2 - Drones
notes.content:
Due to popular demand we have introduced drones to the space combat which, should you be able to afford them, will help you destroy or capture the more powerful ships.

There are six different drones each with a single use!

1. Engine disable drone
2. 200 shield boost drone
3. Explosive drone
4. Emergency flee drone
5. Instant Beam-in drone
6. Atomic Drone!

You can purchase them from any Tech Shop 

Have fun!

notes.title: 1.1 Patch - Spooky Space
notes.content:
The spooky space patch adds various bug fixes to the game and a new area of space where players can complete quests to build up their own Space-Station. 

Players will get bonuses for building up certain areas, such as free mech repair for building a mech bay. 

Involves:

     * New quests
     * Special bonuses
     * A new place to hang out when off duty.
